sources.entry: Arm Neoverse V2 Core Software Optimization Guide - States every stage of one Arm core from fetch to issue, then per-instruction latency, throughput and pipe assignment.

summary.title: Arm Neoverse V2 Software Optimization Guide
summary.one_liner: This Arm guide describes the Neoverse V2 core micro-architecture features that affect software performance, but the page itself only offers a PDF download.
keywords: how to optimize code for arm neoverse
takeaways: The guide covers aspects of the Neoverse V2 core micro-architecture that influence software performance.
Per the listing, it walks through each pipeline stage from fetch to issue.
Per the listing, it gives per-instruction latency, throughput and pipe assignment.
Version 3.0 is marked latest; version 2.0 is superseded.
The content is only available as a PDF download from this page.
summary.summary: The page is a landing page for the Arm Neoverse V2 Software Optimization Guide, version 3.0 (latest), with version 2.0 listed as superseded. The page text states the document is only available as a PDF, so the technical content itself is not visible here. The description and the listing note say the guide covers the core micro-architecture that affects software performance, including stages from fetch to issue and per-instruction latency, throughput and pipe assignment. The rest of the page is cookie consent text and download prompts, which were ignored.
